remarks: Built in 2018 and cherished by its original owner, this well-maintained home offers modern comfort, low wear-and-tear, and an inviting sense of care throughout. Location convenience to SLO’s Public Market and Trader Joe’s, with quick access to freeway entrances, 10 minutes to downtown, major retail, and just 15 minutes to the beach. Cal Poly University is also nearby, making this an exceptional Central Coast location. Inside, the home features natural light, an open-concept living area, and a kitchen designed for those who love to cook.
